issues.where: night-side right limb and lower-right limb southeast of South America; pair-02-b.png crops E, H and I
issues.what: The small, bright green auroral knots at the right edge and the isolated green streak farther down are greatly dimmed. The dark side loses those distinct accents.
issues.fix: Restore the localized green cores and their soft halos at the target positions without lifting the surrounding blacks.

issues.where: upper-right auroral curtain; pair-02-b.png crop C
issues.what: The aurora reads a little more diffuse and less striated, with a broader colored veil near the rim instead of the target's more distinct green rays.
issues.fix: Bring back the separation and vertical reach of the brighter green filaments and restrain the diffuse wash between them.

issues.where: lit upper and left limb and the lower arc; pair-02-b.png crops B, D, F, G and H
issues.what: The left glow looks a touch paler, while a thin, more defined cyan outline is visible along the lower arc where the target fades more gently into space.
issues.fix: Keep the target's saturated blue atmospheric falloff on the lit side and soften and dim the narrow lower outline.

issues.what: The illuminated lunar surface reads marginally dimmer and less distinct against space.
issues.fix: Lift the lit lunar midtones slightly and recover the fine crater contrast without lifting the terminator.

issues.where: blue horizon, particularly the center of the arc; pair-04-b.png crops B and C
issues.what: The inner atmospheric band is slightly paler and less saturated blue than the target.
issues.fix: Remove a little warm fill from the inner band and restore the cooler blue transition into the sky without moving the horizon.

issues.where: cloud-shadow trains across the central sun glitter and lower-left water; pair-04-b.png crops A, D, F, G and H
issues.what: The cloud shadows take on a little warm fill, and the separation between their dark cores, the cloud edges and the bright water is slightly flatter.
issues.fix: Cool and deepen the shadow cores slightly and restore local contrast at the cloud and specular edges while preserving the light direction.
